lines.text: Many learners say: I need some informations.

native.tip: كلمة information لا تُجمع: “I need some information.” وليس “I need some informations.”.
native.caption: هل تقول أحيانًا “I need some informations.” 😅 كلمة information لا تُجمع، فالجملة الصحيحة “I need some information.” استمع إلى Ama وكرّر! تدرّب أكثر في تطبيق Lexkite.
native.comment: الإجابة: “information”. كلمة information لا تُجمع. اختبار مجاني هنا: {link}

en.hook: Do you say “I need some informations”?
en.tip: Information has no plural: “I need some information.” not “I need some informations.”.
en.caption: Do you sometimes say “I need some informations.” 😅 Information has no plural, so the right sentence is “I need some information.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
